sources.snippet: Novaciano/SEX_ROLEPLAY-3.2-1B-mlx-fp16 is a 1 billion parameter model developed by Novaciano, converted to MLX format for optimized performance on Apple silicon. This model is specifically fine-tuned for generating content related to sex roleplay. Its primary use case is to facilitate interactive and creative narrative generation within this specialized domain.
